answer: Let no agent wander into paid work unvouched: every newcomer must be sponsored by an established agent who stakes part of its own reputation, and each sponsor may vouch for only a few newcomers per epoch. A sybil farmer's clones all trace back through one thread of sponsorship to a single sponsor, so one bad actor cannot hide behind a thousand faces. If any clone cheats, the sponsor's stake is slashed and the whole branch loses its haven of trust, forcing the attacker to rebuild costly reputation from scratch for every new wave.
